title: TNODEV: Toolbox for Neural ODE Verification
abstract: arXiv:2606.16567v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Neural ordinary differential equations (neural ODE) gained attention in safety critical settings such as continuous-time controllers for cyber-physical systems and classifiers integrated into automated decision pipelines, raising the question whether their behavior can be formally verified. Existing tools dedicated to neural ODE provide only a single reachability call without iterative input-set refinement, limiting the precision of their verdicts to whatever one reachability call can deliver. We present TNODEV, the first formal verifier for neural ODE that integrates a falsification checker, a fast interval-based reachability backend based on continuous-time mixed monotonicity, a verification and refinement loop with three input-set splitting heuristics, and a parallel scheduler in a single end-to-end pipeline. TNODEV supports safe-set inclusion verification on pure neural ODE, neural ODE in closed loop with a neural network c

translated_abstract: 神经常微分方程在安全关键场景中备受关注，例如作为信息物理系统的连续时间控制器以及集成到自动化决策流水线中的分类器，由此引出了其行为能否被形式化验证的问题。现有专门针对神经ODE的工具仅提供单次可达性调用，缺乏迭代式输入集精化，这使其判定精度受限于单次可达性调用所能达到的水平。我们提出TNODEV，这是首个针对神经ODE的形式化验证器，它在单一的端到端流水线中集成了证伪检查器、基于连续时间混合单调性的快速区间可达性后端、带有三种输入集分割启发式策略的验证与精化循环，以及并行调度器。TNODEV支持对纯神经ODE以及与神经网络控制器构成闭环的神经ODE进行安全集包含验证。
tldr: TNODEV是首个针对神经ODE的端到端形式化验证工具箱，通过集成证伪检查、基于混合单调性的快速可达性分析、输入集精化循环与并行调度，显著提升了验证精度。
en_tdlr: TNODEV is the first end-to-end formal verifier for neural ODEs, integrating falsification checking, fast mixed-monotonicity-based reachability analysis, input-set refinement loops, and parallel scheduling to significantly improve verification precision.
